summary: Removed redundant cd command when terminal already in correct directory. Added pathsAreEquivalent() helper function that normalizes paths and handles case-insensitive comparison on Windows. Modified invokeClaude() and invokeClaudeAsync() to skip cd when cwd matches terminal.cwd. Commands are now just 'claude --dangerously-skip-permissions' instead of 'cd /d "path" && "claude" --dangerously-skip-permissions'.
current_status: Command building now skips redundant cd when terminal already in target directory.
